request.label: r3-refresh3-affordability
command:
from pathlib import Path
import json,math,statistics,sys
from resources import atomic,identity
from task2r_run import balance

root = Path(sys.argv[1])
ev, sci = root/"evidence", root/"science-r3"
ledger = root/"accounting.json"
def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())
def run_budget(label):
    seal = ev/(label+".json")
    native = sci/label/"state.result.json"
    data, outcome = read(seal), read(native)
    measured = data["timing"]
    rows = [row["disjoint_seconds"] for row in data["observed"]]
    assert data["status"] == "PASS" and data["final_time"] == .08 and len(rows) > 2
    warm = rows[2:]
    scopes = {key:statistics.mean(row[key] for row in warm) for key in warm[0]}
    fixed = sum(measured[key] for key in (
        "construction_seconds","initialisation_seconds","final_export_seconds","process_remainder_seconds"))
    return dict(seal=identity(seal),native_result=identity(native),steps=len(rows),
        complete_seconds=measured["complete_step_seconds"],whole_seconds=measured["process_seconds"],
        attributed_fraction=measured["attributed_fraction"],equation_model_share=measured["equation_share"],
        disjoint_whole_step_engine_seconds=measured["engine_seconds"],first_engines=[sum(row.values()) for row in rows[:2]],
        warm_complete_seconds=measured["warm_step_mean_seconds"],warm_engine_seconds=sum(scopes.values()),
        warm_engine_scopes=scopes,fixed_seconds=fixed,other_per_step=measured["other_step_seconds"]/len(rows),
        frame_write_seconds=max(v["write_seconds"] for v in data["frames"].values()),
        frame_bytes=max(v["bytes"] for v in data["frames"].values()),
        recovery_write_seconds=max(outcome["recovery_seconds"]),
        recovery_bytes=max(r["bytes"] for r in data["recoveries"]))

coarse = {role:run_budget(label) for role,label in (
    ("developed_quiet","r3-quiet-refresh3"),("retained_inlet","r3-retained-refresh3-coarse"),
    ("certified_signed","r3-signed-refresh3-uninterrupted"))}
finer = {role:run_budget(label) for role,label in (
    ("retained_inlet","r3-retained-refresh3-middle"),("certified_signed","r3-signed-refresh3-middle"))}
time_paths=[ev/f"r3-{role}-refresh3-common-t{stamp}.json"
            for role in ("signed","retained") for stamp in ("004","008")]
assert all(read(path)["status"]=="MET" for path in time_paths)
audit_names=("r3-audit-signed-refresh3-uninterrupted","r3-audit-signed-refresh3-resumed","r3-audit-refresh3-signed-middle-endpoint",
    "r3-audit-refresh3-retained-coarse-endpoint","r3-audit-refresh3-retained-middle-endpoint")
audit_files=[sci/name/"audit.json" for name in audit_names]
assert all(read(path)["accepted_time_discrete_equations_status"]=="MET" for path in audit_files)
audit_charge=max(read(root/"operations"/name/"receipt.json")["result"]["seconds"] for name in audit_names)
cold=ev/"r3-signed-refresh3-comparison.json"
assert read(cold)["status"]=="MET"
resume=ev/"r3-signed-refresh3-resumed.json"
restart=read(resume)["timing"]["process_seconds"]
failure_label="r3-time-startup-2-recovered"
native_failure=sci/failure_label/"state.failure.json"
with native_failure.open() as fp:
    header=fp.read(256*1024).split(",\"state\":",1)[0]
rejected=json.loads(header+"}")["failed_attempt"]["seconds"]
retry=max(max(v["complete_seconds"]) for v in coarse.values())
horizon, terminal=505.02466521278404,447.8483832973273
pilot_min=26.13350407707765
full_steps=math.ceil(horizon/.02)
pilot_steps=math.ceil(pilot_min/.02)
def boundary_steps(t,dt):
    left=math.floor(t/dt)
    if math.isclose(t,left*dt,rel_tol=0,abs_tol=1e-12):
        return {left}
    return {left,left+1}
def model(cases,dt,steps,begin,end,science_stride,recovery_stride):
    maximum=lambda key:max(row[key] for row in cases.values())
    chosen=max(cases,key=lambda key:cases[key]["warm_engine_seconds"])
    ref=cases[chosen]
    frames=set(range(science_stride,steps+1,science_stride))
    frames.update(boundary_steps(begin,dt),boundary_steps(end,dt),{steps})
    lo,hi=min(boundary_steps(begin,dt)),max(boundary_steps(end,dt))
    recoveries=steps//recovery_stride
    disjoint=dict(fixed=maximum("fixed_seconds"),first_be=max(row["first_engines"][0] for row in cases.values()),
      first_bdf2=max(row["first_engines"][1] for row in cases.values()),
      warmed_step_engines=(steps-2)*ref["warm_engine_seconds"],
      step_orchestration=steps*maximum("other_per_step"),
      scientific_writes=len(frames)*maximum("frame_write_seconds"),
      scheduled_recovery_writes=recoveries*maximum("recovery_write_seconds"),
      one_rejected_native_step=rejected,one_accepted_retry_provision=retry,one_complete_cold_replay=restart,
      independent_final_assessment=audit_charge)
    subtotal=sum(disjoint.values())
    return dict(dt=dt,steps=steps,final_clock=steps*dt,rate_class=chosen,
                rate_engine_seconds=ref["warm_engine_seconds"],rate_complete_seconds=ref["warm_complete_seconds"],
                sampled_warm_rebuild_seconds=ref["warm_engine_scopes"]["rebuild"],
                scopes=disjoint,subtotal_seconds=subtotal,margin=1.25,wall_seconds_with_margin=1.25*subtotal,
                scientific_frames=len(frames),terminal_frames=sum(lo<=index<=hi for index in frames),
                terminal_brackets_seconds=[[i*dt for i in sorted(boundary_steps(point,dt))] for point in (begin,end)],
                scheduled_recovery_writes=recoveries,raw_scientific_bytes=len(frames)*maximum("frame_bytes"),
                raw_recovery_bytes=recoveries*maximum("recovery_bytes"))
production=model(coarse,.02,full_steps,terminal,horizon,2,2)
coarse_pilot=model(coarse,.02,pilot_steps,0.,pilot_min,2,435)
finer_pilot=model(finer,.01,2*pilot_steps,0.,pilot_min,4,870)
assert production["wall_seconds_with_margin"]>86400
roles=(*coarse,"alternate_signed_shape_or_sign")
stock_paths=[ev/f"r3-stock-coarse-{i}.json" for i in (1,2,3)]
stock=[read(path) for path in stock_paths]
assert all(row["status"]=="MET" for row in stock)
median=statistics.median(row["process_seconds"] for row in stock)
warm_stock=statistics.median(row["warmed_mean_seconds"] for row in stock)
comparison={role:dict(whole_ratio=run["whole_seconds"]/median,warm_ratio=run["warm_complete_seconds"]/warm_stock)
            for role,run in coarse.items()}
atomic(Path(sys.argv[2]),dict(schema="WJH27R3MeasuredAffordabilityV1", science_recipe={"timestep":.02,"finer_witness":.01,
    "finite_difference_displacement":4e-6,"factor_maximum_uses":3,"cold":identity(cold),"comparisons":[identity(p) for p in time_paths],
    "independent_equation_audits":[identity(p) for p in audit_files]}, observed_classes=coarse,
    finer_observed_classes=finer, stock=dict(reports=[identity(p) for p in stock_paths],median_process_seconds=median,
    median_warm_seconds=warm_stock,coupled_ratios=comparison), production=production,
    trajectories=[dict(name=role,observed_class_rate=coarse.get(role,{}).get("warm_engine_seconds"),
       planning_seconds_with_margin=production["wall_seconds_with_margin"]) for role in roles],
    projected_four_trajectory_seconds_with_margin=4*production["wall_seconds_with_margin"],
    r4=dict(status="HELD",classes=list(roles),coarse=coarse_pilot,finer=finer_pilot,
        minimum_endpoint=pilot_min,recovery_times=[8.7,17.4,26.1],unmeasured_coarse_class=roles[-1],
        unmeasured_finer_classes=["developed_quiet",roles[-1]],
        conditional_coarse_campaign_seconds=4*coarse_pilot["wall_seconds_with_margin"],
        conditional_with_four_finer_runs_seconds=4*(coarse_pilot["wall_seconds_with_margin"]+finer_pilot["wall_seconds_with_margin"]),
        required_before_admission=["Independently certify the alternate perturbation.",
          "Measure matching finer trajectories at common physical times.", "Retain all three scheduled recovery files.",
          "Verify live worker, memory and disk checks, restart lineage and streamed scientific reduction."]),
    retry_basis=dict(native_failed_attempt=identity(native_failure),rejected_seconds=rejected,
                     retry_complete_step_seconds=retry,restarted_process=identity(resume),restart_process_seconds=restart),
    clock_scope="One rank on CPU 0 with all six numerical libraries at one thread. Class maxima provide conditional planning rates for the unmeasured classes.",
    remaining_costs=["Streaming and retention implementation", "Production output reduction and terminal assessment cost",
                      "Alternate perturbation cost and representative long-interval rejected-step frequency"],
    research_ledger=identity(ledger), research_account=balance(read(ledger)),
    day_target_seconds=86400, day_status="MISSED", TASK2_COMPLETE="NO", TASK3_READY="NO"))
